accepted.evidence: Andersen's sādhika- 'having excess or a surplus, excessive' head explicitly brackets its Sanskrit/Pali comparanda as [sa + adhika-] and cross-references adhika-. The installed adhika- 'exceeding' source head has accepted rank-1 Turner 250 ancestry. Preserve the source's synchronically transparent sa- formation as derived, rather than asserting direct reflex of bare adhika-.

Andersen prints amisa- 'unmixed' with the compound aṁmisam-deva- and separately lists amisamdevā 'see amisa-'; the deva- 'god' head on printed p. 154 explicitly cross-references amisamdeva-. Turner 567 gives Ashokan amisā under ámiśra 'unmixed', and Turner 6523 gives Ashokan devā under dēvá 'god'. Both source heads already have accepted rank-1 ancestry; retain both lexical components.
